semantics: acc[m,n] = sum_k int32(x1[m,k]) * int32(x2[n,k]); inputs require accumulator in int32 range
value = float32(acc); value = float32(value * x1Scale[m]); value = float32(value * x2Scale[n]); preserve these staged FP32 operations
yScale[m] = max_n(activation[m,n]) / 127 if row max > 0, otherwise 1
case_domain: positive finite input scales; dimensions and inputs pinned by case-suite.json
correctness: int8 output exact; yScale rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-4, maximum error fraction=1e-4
timing: three warmups and five ACL event samples around run_kernel; event milliseconds converted to microseconds; excludes allocation, input/output transfers and CPU reference. Candidate host code may launch NPU computation, never compute the operator on CPU or hide host/device transfers. Separate msprof task-time=l1 evidence must match the candidate and device. Event intervals are not pure device instruction cycles.
resource_note: availableCoreNum reports Cube cores. AIV/memory capacity fields 0 mean unknown, never inferred from Cube cores.
